BiblicalUsage: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man, the destruction of the poor is their poverty, Agur prays, give me neither poverty nor riches, and the poor may drink and forget their poverty.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that poverty is the wage of the slack hand, and the prayer of the wise man is neither poverty nor riches.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
